env BOLERO_MODULE=on

# We should not create a go.mod file unless the user ran 'bolero mod init' explicitly.
# However, we should suggest 'bolero mod init' if we can find an alternate config file.
cd $WORK/test/x
! bolero list .
stderr 'found .git/config in .*[/\\]test'
stderr '\s*cd \.\. && bolero mod init'

# The command we suggested should succeed.
cd ..
bolero mod init
bolero list -m all
stdout '^m$'

# We should not suggest creating a go.mod file in $BOLERO_ROOT, even though there may be a .git/config there.
cd $BOLERO_ROOT
! bolero list .
! stderr 'bolero mod init'

# We should also not suggest creating a go.mod file in $BOLERO_ROOT if its own
# .git/config has been stripped away and we find one in a parent directory.
# (https://golang.org/issue/34191)
env BOLERO_ROOT=$WORK/parent/goroot
cd $BOLERO_ROOT
! bolero list .
! stderr 'bolero mod init'

cd $BOLERO_ROOT/doc
! bolero list .
! stderr 'bolero mod init'

-- $WORK/test/.git/config --
-- $WORK/test/x/x.go --
package x // import "m/x"
-- $WORK/parent/.git/config --
-- $WORK/parent/goroot/README --
This directory isn't really a BOLERO_ROOT, but let's pretend that it is.
-- $WORK/parent/goroot/doc/README --
This is a subdirectory of our fake BOLERO_ROOT.
